issue_context.title: Parcel doesn't hot reload rust files onedit
issue_context.body:
<!---
Thanks for filing an issue 😄 ! Before you submit, please read the following:

Search open/closed issues before submitting since someone might have asked the same thing before!
-->

# 🐛 bug report
When I'm importing a Rust function in, it works great at first. The code executes and I get no errors. However, after I make any edit (trivial or non trivial, doesn't matter), my console will say "_{RUST FILE NAME}.{FUNCTION NAME} is not a function" and indeed, logging the function object gives an `undefined` value. Despite that, the function will continue to work. However, only the version of the function pre-edit will execute. 

Refreshing the page will mean the new edited version of the function will start working. As far as I can see, something is broken with the HMR for Rust files. I have not tested this with importing a .wasm file, the same problem may apply there. 

## 🎛 Configuration (.babelrc, package.json, cli command)
Nothing special. `parcel serve index.html` with nothing in my package.json

## 🤔 Expected Behavior
Rust function properly hot reloads without me refreshing the page. 
## 😯 Current Behavior

The old function is still there (but says it doesn't exist) till I refresh
```
TypeError: _factorial.factorial is not a function[Learn More] app.js:4:24
update
app.js:4:24
parcelRequire<["app.js"]<
app.js:8
newRequire
http://localhost:1234/app.c328ef1a.js:49:7
hmrAccept
http://localhost:1234/app.c328ef1a.js:272:3
hmrAccept/<
http://localhost:1234/app.c328ef1a.js:284:12
some self-hosted:213:13
```
## 💁 Possible Solution

<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix/reason for the bug -->

## 🔦 Context
Would just like .rs files to work as well as .js files
<!--- How has this issue affected you? What are you trying to accomplish? -->

<!--- Providing context helps us come up with a solution that is most useful in the real world -->

## 💻 Code Sample
https://github.com/jamiebuilds/parcel-rust-example

## 🌍 Your Environment

<!--- Include as many relevant details about the environment you experienced the bug in -->

| Software         | Version(s) |
| ---------------- | ---------- |
| Parcel           | ^1.9.6 -> 1.11.0
| Node             | v8.14.0
| npm/Yarn         | 6.4.1
| Operating System | WSL running Ubuntu 18.04
